title: Super Admin Backup Delete Permission

items.action: create backups and create/start restore workflows

database.reason: Fair CRM product persistence is unchanged; the companion Core change adds only a permission catalog row.

menu.reason: Backup navigation remains guarded by the existing system-scoped backups.read permission.

visual_qa.reason: No visual layout or copy is changed; this delivery changes authorization semantics and permission synchronization.

notes: Backup delete is a distinct system-scoped, non-assignable capability supplied by Core and therefore remains Super Admin-only. Restore intentionally remains on fair_crm.admin.backups.create per product decision. Delete routes and the delete use case must check fair_crm.admin.backups.delete; existing organization scoping and destructive-action audit behavior remain intact.
